item.title: Former Obama Admin Official Says Trump Progress In Deporting Illegal Immigrants Is ‘Remarkable Accomplishment’
item.description: A former acting director of the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) described the number of people deported during the Trump administration as a “remarkable accomplishment” on Thursday on MSNOW.

item.title: Interpol Operation Thunder 2025 Rescues 30,000 Animals, Seizes Record Wildlife Trafficking Haul
item.description: Among the rescued animals were 6,160 birds, 2,040 tortoises and turtles, 1,150 reptiles, 208 primates, and 10 big cats, including endangered tigers.

item.title: Charlie Kirk’s Alleged Assassin Smirks During First In-Person Hearing
item.description: Tyler Robinson, the alleged assassin of Turning Point USA founder Charlie Kirk, could be seen smirking on Thursday during his first in-person pre-trial court hearing.

item.title: MTG Walks Out Of Interview
item.description: Republican Georgia Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene walked out of a Wednesday interview with 11Alive as "The Georgia Vote" co-anchor Zach Merchant pressed her on her past political rhetoric.

item.title: Candace Owens Slams Erika Kirk Over TPUSA Leadership, Compares Widow’s Grief to BLM Tactics
item.description: “It is a positively ABSURD notion that you cannot critique a 150 million dollar organization because the CEO says they are like a family, and are grieving."

item.title: 20 Republicans Rebuke Trump Executive Order, Side With Democrats
item.description: More than a dozen House Republicans joined their Democratic colleagues Wednesday to rebuke the Trump administration on federal union organizing.

item.title: Indiana Redistricting Push Goes Down In Flames As Majority Of Republicans Reject Trump’s Appeals
item.description: Republicans’ bid to redraw Indiana’s congressional map ahead of the 2026 midterms collapsed Thursday after 21 GOP state senators broke with their party and joined Democrats in voting down new district lines.

item.title: US Plans To Seize More ‘Shadow’ Tankers Off Venezuela, Per Reports
item.description: The U.S. is reportedly planning to seize more oil tankers off the coast of Venezuela after successfully carrying out the first such operation on Wednesday.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: GOP Montana Lawmakers Celebrate As Trump Demolishes Biden-Era Assault On Their Resources
item.description: President Donald Trump signed Montana lawmakers' bill to unleash mining in the state on Thursday, demolishing a Biden-era plan that held the coal-rich region hostage.

item.title: MARK KERR And CHRISTOPHER NEIWEEM: Trump And Kennedy Should Crack Down On Fake Weight Loss Drugs
item.description: One of us is a former UFC Champion, and the other is an Army veteran who served in the Second Iraq War, and now we both live without a daily physical regimen meant to keep us in fighting shape. To stay lean, we keep active and regulate what we eat.
